    {"name": "occupation", "event": "Before the call, from client profile", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "contacts_this_run", "event": "During the call, the count of contacts in this campaign up to and including this call", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.8},
